text_block_list.text:
After searching all over for Gentildonna, 
who hadn't shown up for training—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. When you need to think deeply, 
there's nothing quite like being 
underwater.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is a serene and refined realm where 
only those with strong cardiovascular 
endurance can remain.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "...Oh, Trainer. What are you doing here?"

I informed her that training time was 
already over and gave proper guidance as a 
Trainer to make sure she would be more 
careful next time.
